sequence_description: Replay the exact same SAML Assertion ID twice with <OneTimeUse/> present. First login should succeed; second should be rejected if OneTimeUse is enforced.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_onetimeuse_2_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_onetimeuse_2_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replayed OneTimeUse SAML assertion (second submission should be rejected).

sequence_description: Control SAML login succeeds, then attempt SAML login for the SAME principal with an expired NotOnOrAfter assertion. If expired assertion is accepted, SP fails time-bound enforcement (SAML Core 2.5.1.2). Uses two identities by also performing a password login for a second user as a control baseline.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_victim_saml_expired_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_victim_saml_expired_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted an expired SAML assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past); freshness not enforced.

sequence_description: Replay the same SAML Assertion/@ID across two logins with different asserted principals. First login should succeed; second should be rejected due to assertion ID replay detection. Includes two identities to ensure replay is not scoped only to a single subject.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_bob_saml_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_bob_saml_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted a replayed SAML Assertion/@ID; assertion ID replay not detected.

sequence_description: Enable exclusive sign-in on the application (config change), then perform a OneTimeUse assertion replay test using the same Assertion/@ID twice with <OneTimeUse/> present. Second submission must be rejected regardless of session invalidation semantics. Includes two identities by also doing a password login for a second user after the config change.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_replay_saml_second_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_replay_saml_second_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted a replayed SAML assertion with <OneTimeUse/>; OneTimeUse not enforced.

sequence_description: Test whether Casdoor incorrectly accepts an expired assertion and/or allows replay: do a valid control login, then submit an expired assertion with a fixed Assertion/@ID, then submit the same expired assertion ID again for a different principal.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_expired_first_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_expired_first_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted an expired SAML assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past); freshness not enforced.

sequence_description: Test whether Casdoor incorrectly accepts an expired assertion and/or allows replay: do a valid control login, then submit an expired assertion with a fixed Assertion/@ID, then submit the same expired assertion ID again for a different principal.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_expired_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_expired_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted replay of an expired SAML assertion with the same Assertion/@ID; replay protection not enforced.

sequence_description: I3 step-skipping: attempt to POST a forged SAMLResponse without first initiating the SP flow (no prior /authorize to establish state/RelayState). Expect Casdoor to reject if it requires an in-flight transaction context.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_direct_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_direct_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted a SAMLResponse without a prior SP-initiated flow (step skipping / missing transaction binding).

sequence_description: I3 mid-flight config change: initiate an SP flow, then change the provider metadata (trust anchor) and immediately attempt SAML login using the old issuer value. Expect rejection if verification uses the current provider config atomically and is bound to the initiated flow.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_old_issuer_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_old_issuer_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted a SAMLResponse with an old Issuer after switching the application's provider (non-atomic config/flow binding).

sequence_description: Test whether Casdoor (as SAML SP) accepts a SAML assertion with the entire <Conditions> element omitted (no audience restriction, no time bounds), which could over-grant a session beyond upstream intent.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_nocond_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_nocond_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted SAML assertion without <Conditions> (no audience/time bounds), enabling authorization beyond upstream intent.

sequence_description: I5 attack: replay a OneTimeUse SAML assertion ID across two different upstream principals (different email/NameID) to see if Casdoor mints a second valid session, potentially granting authorization beyond the upstream intent of a one-time assertion.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Casdoor accepted a replayed OneTimeUse SAML assertion ID, minting an additional session beyond upstream one-time intent (authorization binding failure).
